title: Dispatch: 71u1 reform a present familiar via recast_bonded_summon (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implement eshyra-71u1 (read it: bd show eshyra-71u1). Parent integration bead: eshyra-71u1. The captain has made every design decision below. Do not re-decide them. If something here contradicts the code or the SRD record text, stop and record the contradiction in your notes rather than improvising.

HARD RULE (bd memory srd-fidelity-hard-blocker): nothing may contradict the SRD. Source: packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json, records spell:find-familiar and spell:find-steed (data.description, data.castingTime, data.mechanics.effects[0].creation.forms, data.mechanics.effects[0].transitions). Do NOT edit records.json or any importer file.

## Source facts
- Find Familiar (casting time 1 hour, ritual): "the familiar has the statistics of the chosen form" ... "If you cast this spell while you already have a familiar, you instead cause it to adopt a new form. Choose one of the forms from the above list. Your familiar transforms into the chosen creature."
  Transition reform-present-familiar: trigger cast-again, when {presence: present, link: active}, operation {kind: select-new-form}, NO changes array (presence is unchanged).
  Transition restore-and-reform-absent-familiar (already executed by s02z): when absent + active, changes presence->present, select-new-form.
  reform-pocketed-familiar (when pocket-dimension): NOT in scope. The engine models no pocket presence; that is bead eshyra-82uk.
- Find Steed has only restore-same-steed (cast-again from absent). No cast-again transition exists for a present steed, so a present steed must stay refused.

## Today (survey)
- packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts: findBondedRecastTransition (~5160) selects only a cast-again transition whose when.presence includes 'absent' and whose changes set presence->present. recastBondedSummon (~5231) validates the effect, then calls the finder BEFORE reading the link and actor. It then calls restoreBondedCampaignActor and appends a 'recast' event. BondedRecastTransition (~5143) carries {id, operation, forms}.
- packages/core/src/state/encounterCombatants.ts restoreBondedCampaignActor (~3142): refuses actor.status !== 'absent' with a "Reforming a present or pocketed familiar is not yet supported" message. It also checks the vanish-bonded rule, hasActiveBondLink, the active-combat projection guard and exhaustion 6. It then computes rulesRef/hpMax (new-form: lookupCreatureRecord + readCreatureHp), sets hpCurrent = effectiveHpMax(hpMax, conditions), and upserts status alive with replaceCombatLifecycle: true.
- packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolRecastBondedSummon.ts: tool description says present/pocketed is refused.
- docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md ~285-312: the recastBondedSummon paragraph.
- packages/core/test/bondedSummonRecast.test.ts: tests at ~198 ("refuses a present steed and says reforming is unsupported") and ~363 ("refuses a present familiar ... out of scope") assert the old refusal.

## Decision (captain, 2026-10-07)
1. Selection by modelled presence. Restructure recastBondedSummon so it reads the single active actor link and its campaign actor BEFORE selecting the transition. Keep the existing effect-level refusals (missing, ended, suppressed, not summoning, wrong spellRef, unknown spell record) in their current order and with their current messages. Map the actor status to presence: 'absent' -> 'absent'; 'alive' -> 'present'. Refuse any other status with a clear message that names the status, before any write (a bonded familiar or steed cannot be dying, stable or dead short of exhaustion 6, and 'escaped', 'inactive', 'unknown' and 'unconscious' are not a presence the recast can reason about). Then find the cast-again transition whose when.presence includes that presence and whose when.link includes 'active':
   - For 'absent', require changes presence->present, exactly as today. Keep the existing message "has no cast-again transition that restores an absent creature whose link is active" for that case.
   - For 'present', require that the transition changes no presence (no changes entry with axis presence). Its operation must be select-new-form; any other operation is refused as not executable (same style as the existing unsupportedOperation refusal). If there is no such transition (Find Steed), refuse with a message saying the spell has no cast-again transition for a present creature whose link is active. For the steed, that means it is already present: the SRD bonds one steed at a time, and its recast only restores an absent steed.
   Never key on the spell name. Generalize BondedRecastTransition minimally, e.g. add from: 'absent' | 'present'.
2. One engine seam. Extend restoreBondedCampaignActor rather than adding a parallel function, so the guards cannot drift. Add an input field expectedPresence: 'absent' | 'present'. For 'present': the actor must be status 'alive', and restore must be {kind: 'new-form'} (refuse 'maximum' as an engine invariant). Every other guard applies unchanged: vanish-bonded rule, active bond link, no combatant in an active combat instance (the casting time is 1 hour; adjust the message wording so it fits both cases), exhaustion level 6 (unreachable for alive, keep it). The write: same actor, rulesRef = form, hpMax = readCreatureHp(form record), hpCurrent = effectiveHpMax(hpMax, actor.conditions), status alive. Conditions, exhaustion, display name, location, state (incl. combat lifecycle and its vanish-bonded rule) stay as stored. For 'absent', behaviour is byte-for-byte as today, except that the present-case wording moves out of the absent refusal. A mismatch between expectedPresence and the actual status is refused. Update the JSDoc above the function: it is now the path from absent back to alive AND the reform of a present bonded familiar.
   HP rationale, for the docs: the familiar "has the statistics of the chosen form", and the source carries no damage across a transformation, so the reformed familiar takes the new form's hit points, as the absent restore already does.
3. Event: the same 'recast' event kind and detail shape. transitionId is the selected transition id (reform-present-familiar), and form is recorded. No new event kind, no migration.
4. Result: RecastBondedSummonResult is unchanged in shape. transitionId reports reform-present-familiar.
5. Texts. Tool description (toolRecastBondedSummon.ts): a recast of Find Familiar while the familiar is present reforms it (form REQUIRED, same actor, new form's HP, stays present). The engine does not track a familiar dismissed to its pocket dimension: such a familiar is recorded as present, and the reform has the same effect. A present Find Steed is refused. Keep the out-of-combat, suppressed, ended/released, and no-spell-slot sentences. Update the encounterCombatants.ts refusal text, which must no longer say reforming is unsupported. Search for any other "not yet supported"/"reforming" text and update it (rg -n -i 'reform|pocket' packages/core/src packages/cli/src docs).
6. Docs: docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md, the recastBondedSummon paragraph. Describe the present reform, the presence-to-transition selection, what it leaves unchanged, that pocket presence is not modelled (eshyra-82uk) and why the reform is still correct for a pocketed familiar (reform-pocketed-familiar has the same operation and no presence change), and the HP rationale. Re-derive every sentence against the source text and the real tool contract. Check other sections that mention reforming (lines ~448, ~514).
7. Exports: no root-export changes. internal.ts only if a new type needs exporting.

## Evidence (packages/core/test/bondedSummonRecast.test.ts; reuse its setup helpers)
Replace the two old present-refusal tests. Assert identities and exact values, and pin no counts:
- Present familiar (bonded as creature:bat, combat closed first) recast with form creature:owl: same actor id, rulesRef creature:owl, hpMax and hpCurrent = the owl record's HP (read it from the record in the test via the same lookup the other familiar test uses, not a literal), status alive, link still active, effect active. The result and the ledger 'recast' event carry transitionId reform-present-familiar and form creature:owl.
- A damaged present familiar (adjust_hp or the existing damage helper below its max, but above 0) reformed into the SAME form returns at that form's full HP. This pins the HP decision.
- A present familiar at exhaustion level 4 reforms to the halved effective maximum.
- Present familiar: form omitted -> refused; a form outside the list -> refused. The actor is unchanged after each.
- Present familiar with a combatant in an active combat instance -> refused, unchanged.
- Present steed -> refused with the new "no cast-again transition for a present creature" message, unchanged.
- A reformed familiar can still vanish at 0 HP (vanish-bonded kept) and then be restored by an absent recast.
- A non-alive, non-absent status (e.g. set the actor 'unconscious' or 'inactive' through whatever engine path the tests can reach; if no path can produce it, say so in your notes and skip this one) -> refused naming the status.
- All existing absent-path tests stay green and unchanged except the two replaced.

## Procedure
Work only in this worktree (/home/jhbongaarts/src/eshyra/.worktrees/eshyra-71u1.1, branch eshyra-71u1.1); use worktree paths only, never the parent checkout. Run npm run verify:worktree from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files). It must be fully green, documented skips only; under heavy machine load the rulesPackAuditCli timeouts are environmental (bd memory rulespack-audit-cli-tests-timeout-under-external-load). Then rerun with VITEST_MAX_FORKS=6. Commit on this branch with a message starting "eshyra-71u1.1 " and ending with the line: Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
